title: seo_plan
description: Who searches for this business and with what words, and what each page says to them in a search result. Written at the plan stage; the audit checks the real pages against it.

who.description: The person searching, in one line: "a parent in Bandung looking for a dentist for a child"

place.description: Where they search from, as the brief gives it ("Dago, Bandung"); null for a business that sells everywhere online

slug.description: As in site_plan.json; "" for the home page

query.description: The words the searcher types to find this page, in the site's language: "dokter gigi anak dago bandung"

intent.description: What they want to do when they land: compare prices, book, find the address

h1.description: The hero headline, the page's one <h1>

profile.description: The businessProfile fields filled, each from a fact in brief.json

from.description: The brief.json fact it comes from

not_done.description: Search pages deliberately not made, with the reason: "no page per city: the clinic serves one area"
